Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the owning company of the Hungry Horse chain is CK Asset Holdings Limited, headquartered in Hong Kong. While it is true that CK Asset Holdings acquired Greene King in 2019, the task specifically asks for the base location of the company that owns the Hungry Horse pub chain. Greene King, the direct owner of Hungry Horse, is based in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, United Kingdom. The Planner mistakenly conflated the ultimate parent company (CK Asset Holdings) with the direct owner (Greene King) and provided the headquarters of the parent company instead of that of the direct owner, which was the focus of the task.
